Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 sDesc valid_communication_codes.description%TYPE;

 cursor cur_comtp (p_comm_type varchar2,
 p_comm_code varchar2) is
 select description
 from valid_communication_codes
 where comm_type = p_comm_type
 and comm_code = p_comm_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1) ;
begin
 if :donor_communications.action_code is not null then
 open cur_comtp('ACTCD', :donor_communications.action_code);
 fetch cur_comtp into sDesc;
 if cur_comtp%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_comtp;
 show_error('18017');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if cur_comtp%ISOPEN then
 close cur_comtp;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- Modified and verified for Y2K....MG.....6/99
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS

 param_addr_id PARAMLIST;
 v_local_date date;
 v_count number;
BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '1.01.06'; -- Set program version
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.00'; -- Set program version
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.00'; -- Set program version
 --:global.program_version := '02'; -- Set program version
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- IM 2390
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- MSYED. To show 4 digits SSN with leading zero's or full 9 digits, based on the database value.
 --:global.program_version := '05'; -- IM 4705
 --:global.program_version := '06'; -- MS IM# 4703
 --:global.program_version := '07'; -- IM 4788--Removed chapter id from comm type LOV
 --:global.program_version := '08'; -- IM 5443--Converted insert date to local
 --:global.program_version := '09'; -- IM 5523--Sysdate conversion for data retrival
 --:global.program_version := '10'; -- IM 8497
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 --:global.program_version := '01';
 -- :global.program_version := '02'; -- IM: 558
 :global.program_version := '03'; -- MLT: 8054
 
 :system.message_level := '10';
 execute_trigger('util_banner');
 --default_value('WAD','global.chapter_id'); -- Set default chapter id
 default_value(:global.chapter_id,'global.chapter_id');
 default_value('USER','global.screen_mode');--Set the screen mode of the user. It could be either SUPER or USER
 -- default_value('SUPER','global.screen_mode');--Set the screen mode of the user. It could be either SUPER or USER

 -- Create a parameter list for calling the windows.
 param_addr_id := Get_Parameter_List('PARAM_DON_ADDR'); 
 if not id_null( param_addr_id ) then 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( param_addr_id ); 
 end if;
 param_addr_id := create_parameter_list('PARAM_DON_ADDR'); 

 /* Initialise sort button global variables */

 :global.sort_donor :='A';
 :global.sort_insert_date:='A';
 :global.sort_comm_code:='A';
 :global.sort_comm_type:='A';
 :global.sort_target_date:='A';
 :global.sort_action_date:='A';
 :global.sort_user_id:='A';

 /* disable unnecessary tollbar buttons */

 set_item_property('toolbar.delete_record',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.insert',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_record',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('toolbar.clear_block',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
-- set_item_property('toolbar.commit_form',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);

 
 :ctrl_blk.from_date := NULL;
 :ctrl_blk.to_date := NULL;

 item_change('ctrl_blk.W_COMM','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.W_PROPR','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.w_dnint','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.w_dndtl','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.w_elgby','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.w_demgr','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.w_card','D');
 
 
 ---SCR:599585, IM: 558
 v_local_date:=Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate);
 begin 
 select count(*)
 into v_count
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'DLCOM'
 and code in (select access_class
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and inter_level > 0 
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_local_date+1))
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_local_date+1);
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in selecting from master codes');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 
 If v_count > 0 then 
 item_change('donor_communications.com_desc','E');
 Else 
 item_change('donor_communications.com_desc','D');
 End If;
 
 

END;

-- Modified and verified for Y2K....MG.....6/99
PROCEDURE do_retrieve_processing IS

 cnt number :=0 ;
 al_id alert;
 alert_button number;
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;
BEGIN 
 -- time zone change --5/16/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:insert_date,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :ctrl_blk.s_insdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 :ctrl_blk.s_insdate := to_date(to_char(:insert_date,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 /* If user cheks pending only then select records with action date as NULL */
--message('Hello 1 '||:global.chapter_id);pause;
--message('Hello 2 '||:ctrl_blk.from_date);pause;
--message('Hello 3 '||to_date(to_char(:ctrl_blk.to_date,'MM-DD-RR')||':23:59', 'MM-DD-RR:HH24:MI'));pause;
--message('Hello 4 '||:ctrl_blk.comm_type);pause;
--message('Hello 5 '||:ctrl_blk.comm_code);pause;
--message('Hello 6 '||:ctrl_blk.user_id);pause;
--message('Hello 7 '||:global.screen_mode);pause;
--message('Hello 8 '||:banner.user_id);pause;

 if :ctrl_blk.pending='T' then

 set_block_property('donor_communications',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID,insert_date) between :ctrl_blk.from_date 
 and to_date(to_char(:ctrl_blk.to_date,''MM-DD-RR'')||'':23:59'',
